When a ruthless adversary strikes close to home, Kara Zor-El, also known as Supergirl, reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion on an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice. The film explores her origin story and a protective quest that helps the young Kryptonian decide who she wants to be. Along the way, she runs into a teen girl seeking revenge while attempting to drink away bad memories on an alien planet.

Comedy & Entertainment

The film leans into an entertaining space-faring adventure with a grounded perspective on its lead character's personality. While reviewers note a rather dark tone and heavy emotional baggage, the unique premise of a pub-crawling Kryptonian celebrating her birthday offers a distinct flavor of entertainment. Its comedic and lighthearted moments are balanced against heavy themes of trauma and revenge.

Reviewers note that it has a rather dark tone, a bare-bones or not particularly memorable villain in Krem, dangling plot threads, and lackluster needle-drops.

Supergirl is a lost, messy, yet worthwhile watch that offers a fresh perspective on Clark Kent's cousin despite its formulaic structure and messy narrative. On the outskirts of a seaside village lives a smelly and perpetually ridiculed Fisherwoman who decides she wants a husband. Fed up with her small-minded neighbors, whose traditional ideas of needing a partner are planted by bitter married women, she meets a local basketmaker. He commissions her a wicker husband, who proves to be the perfect man and sets off a tsunami of jealousy and intrigue in the town.

Comedy & Entertainment

The film delivers a wickedly funny and ribald comedic spell, blending medieval innuendos with an endearing, whimsical fantasy romance. Reviewers note that this rip-roaring comedy remains exciting because the story does not survive on belief alone, guided by rich characters and inspired narrative turns. It offers plenty of entertainment value and laughs without the humor coming at the expense of the characters.

Olivia Colman delivers a three-dimensional performance as the lonely Fisherwoman determined to change her life. Alexander Skarsgård touchingly underplays the Wicker Husband to make him undeniably human, while Peter Dinklage is perfectly cast as the slightly duplicitous Basket Weaver with his own surprises. Strengths

  • Excellent, standout cast
  • Beautiful visuals
  • Wickedly funny and ribald humor
  • Richly drawn characters

Weaknesses

While the film has plenty going for it, some potential risks of the genre include navigating a strange and unconventional premise without losing momentum. The narrative builds to a major consequence and threat to all, meaning viewers looking for a strictly traditional romance might find the bizarre plot developments a bit much to fully embrace.

Final verdict

Wicker is a wickedly funny and inventive fantasy romance that casts a comedic spell from start to finish.
